criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered in the noon world; 5 the strongest, 7 reads as a place. 6 a clock on a slab against empty sky with no ground or Fort Davis; 8 blocks on a shelf before a blank wall with a smudge in the glass base; 4 helmet-haired mannequins on an empty apron with an off-frame shadow and no shade band; 2 a dark disc that reads as a hole and a grey slab on the left; 1 a pink box Capitol and cloned trees. Flat noon light gives most frames a mid band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One type system, haze and noon; two palettes alternate. The bus on four frames, the arm state reading on 1, 5 and 9, none on 6. Two devices working, 6 outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, the 2 and 2025 computed; attribution careful; c39 never without c40; floors stated. Frame 1's 'helped connect the same AI platform' and frame 8's 'brought this Austin charter to that pass rate' run a little loose.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decided and where, two concrete actions and the TimeBack name. Alpha is not explained until 6; c6 is on no frame; 'Back again' points at an unshown first visit.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays the cover, 3 turns, 5 is the climax, 9 acts. 8 would sit better after 2; 4 could fold into 3.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, local and on register. 5's hook is a tally; attribution opens five deks; 9's hook leans on a metaphor; the caption opens weakly.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New topic, but a yellow vehicle on a Texas road a day after no. 41, a TEA beat four days after no. 38, and the pale sky house look.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 6, 8 and 4 as places on ground: the clock under the walkway deck with the rimrock and grama behind and a bus flank, the columns on the oak table with window shadows, and the camera under the covered walk with small walkers turned away.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A clock on a slab against empty sky; no ground, horizon, Fort Davis or bus.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so the clock hangs from the walkway's edge beam over concrete, the rimrock and grama on the lower third and a bus flank at the right edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blocks on a shelf before a blank wall; the 10 block reads as current; a smudge in the glass base.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The long oak table with a raking window; labels on the block and the empty footprint; remove the smudge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Helmet-haired mannequins on a featureless apron; an off-frame shadow; no shade band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera under the covered walk with its shade band across the foreground; walkers smaller and turned away; grit and joints on the walk.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A dark disc that reads as a hole; a grey slab on the left.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A lit carved seal with a cast shadow; crop the slab; rake window light across the wall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin parent on the asphalt in profile; the bus reads as a toy.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The parent on the kerb, turned away, with a shadow; the oak's shade across the kerb.
